title: My roadmap
previewEmptyBody: Pick a goal and get one small step at a time.

exam.why: This exam is a door on your path. Its date is fixed, so we plan around it.
exam.now: Open last year's paper and try 10 questions.

program.why: This course is the main route to the work you want.
program.now: List 3 colleges near you that offer it.

scheme.why: Money that needs no work. It helps pay for your studies.
scheme.now: Open the scheme and see what it asks for.

document.why: A scheme or admission will ask for this.
document.now: Ask at home if you already have it.

course.why: Free learning that builds the skill step by step.
course.now: Open it and finish the first lesson.

milestone.why: A point on your path. Its date is set by school, law or your goal.
milestone.now: Keep going with the step before it.

milestone_gate.why: The law sets this age. We keep this date as it is and use the time to build skills.
milestone_gate.now: Use this time for studies and free skill training.

task.why: A small step that moves you forward.

community.why: People who walked this path can save you months.
community.now: Ask one question in the community.

job.why: Earning while you learn, safely and fairly paid.

micro.why: A small start is still a start.

stretch.why: You are moving fast. This is extra, only if you want.
stretch.now: Try it when you have energy.

error: That did not work. Please try again.
offlineBody: Your roadmap will load when you are back online.
emptyBody: Pick a career, exam or scholarship. We turn it into small dated steps that change with you.

hero.reassure: One small step at a time. We made your next steps smaller.
hero.welcome_back: Welcome back. A fresh start: nothing is lost.
hero.money: Scholarships come first on your plan.
hero.busy: Your plan fits the time you have.
hero.gentle: Small steps this week. You can do this.
hero.cheer: You're ahead of your plan. Great going!
hero.neutral: Your plan changes by itself to fit how you are doing.

sample: Sample roadmap (the server is not connected)
notReady: Automatic changes start after the next update.
noChanges: Nothing changed yet. We'll tell you here when we adjust your plan.

reason.at_risk: "{{step}}" has a fixed date in {{days}} days. We kept it and moved other steps around it.
reason.fresh_start: Welcome back. We gave your plan a fresh start from Monday and made the next step small. Nothing is lost.
reason.respace_busy: You've been busy, so we spaced out the next steps. Fixed dates did not move.
reason.split_busy: We split "{{step}}" into a smaller first step because you've been busy.
reason.split_worry: You said this feels like a lot, so we made "{{step}}" smaller.
reason.stretch: You are ahead. We added an optional extra step. Skip it if you like.
reason.pull_in: You're moving fast, so "{{step}}" is now a week sooner.
reason.money_first: Money is tight right now, so scholarships come first.
reason.earn_while_learning: Money is tight right now, so scholarships and earning while you learn come first.
reason.goal_added_saathi: Added the goal "{{title}}" from your chat with Saathi.
reason.evidence_lesson_completed: Saathi noticed you finished a lesson.
reason.evidence_scheme_viewed: Saathi noticed you opened a scholarship.
reason.evidence_community_post: Saathi noticed you asked in the community.
reason.evidence_credential_issued: Saathi noticed your teacher approved your skill.
reason.evidence_job_viewed: Saathi noticed you looked at openings.

minorAlerts: Under 18: we alert you about scholarships, skills and safe training, not jobs.
noAlerts: Ask Saathi to watch an exam, scholarship or job for you.
